supporting_pages.title: "(Deprecated) Data Mesh User Guide \_|\_ Google Cloud Cortex Framework \_\
evidence_snippets: Data Mesh for Cortex Framework extends the data foundation to enable data governance, discoverability, and access control through BigQuery metadata and Dataplex Universal Catalog .
Dataplex Universal Catalog provides a unified API, enhanced metadata capabilities, and new features for a more comprehensive data governance experience.

The following sections are particularly relevant: Roles interact Authorization inheritance Masking rules and hierarchy Policy tag best practices Cortex Framework provides sample policy tags to demonstrate how they are specified and potential uses, however resources that affect access control are not enabled in the Data Mesh deployment by default.
